sections.heading: Overview
content: This policy outlines Humana’s reimbursement for time-based service codes.

sections.heading: Kentucky Medicaid Payment Policy
content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Time-based service codes are used by providers to document and bill for services that are measured and reimbursed according to the amount of time spent delivering the service. Examples include prolonged services and certain evaluation and management (E/M), therapy and care management services. Humana allows units for time-based service codes at the lesser of: • The limitation outlined in any applicable Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) policy or guidance; • The limitation outlined in any applicable Kentucky Department for Medicaid Services (KDMS) policy or guidance; • The limitation outlined in any applicable Humana policy or guidance, including but not limited to, the Humana Healthy Horizons in Kentucky Policies Booklet available in the References section of this policy; or • For each date of service, the maximum number of units that equals a single 24-hour period.

sections.heading: General Humana Resources
content: • Availity – Providers can register for access to information on a variety of topics such as eligibility, benefits, referrals, authorizations, claims and electronic remittances. • Claims processing edit notifications – Alerts of upcoming claims payment changes are posted on the first Friday of each month. • Claims resources – Providers can find information on referrals, authorizations, electronic claim submissions and more. • Making it easier – This page contains an educational series for providers and healthcare professionals. • Medical and pharmacy coverage policies – Humana publishes determinations of coverage of medical procedures, devices and medications for the treatment of various conditions. There may be variances in coverage among plans. • Publications – This page can help you find our quarterly newsletter, provider manual and other resources to help you do business with us. Note : Links to sources outside of Humana’s control are verified at the time of publication. Please report broken links .
